recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-16842 unless a future work group decision changes the generic CanonicalResource.description guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-16842 was a Published/Persuasive CQI change request for STU3 Measure.description. It objected that the example referred to "the language of the profile" and seemed to assume measures were always profiles; the accepted resolution was to clarify the wording so the example applied to description.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN 14852. The mirrored git commit d6775d2e5c070e7cf9a2ee0a6fcb41b52fde6420 changed the Measure and MetadataResource spreadsheet wording from "language of the profile ... place the profile was created" to the templated "language of the {{title}} ... place the {{title}} was created," applying the issue before later source refactors moved Measure into structuredefinition-Measure.xml.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml comment says "the language of the measure is presumed to be the predominant language in the place the measure was created." The Measure Definition mapping exception carries the same wording. Later Published issue FHIR-35986 removed the separate "why the measure was built" overlap from CanonicalResource.description comments while preserving this FHIR-16842 clarification. Searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion and no current source occurrence of the old profile wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no source changes because the current authoritative Measure source and its adjacent mapping exception already reflect the accepted clarification.

related_jiras.note: Broader R5 cleanup of CanonicalResource.description comments removed "why the measure was built" while preserving the measure-specific language example that resolved FHIR-16842.
